message.content:
Buddhism was founded by **Siddhārtha Gautāma**, who later became known as *the Buddha* (“the awakened one”). He lived around the 5th–4th centuries BC.  
**Origin:** His enlightenment took place on the banks of the river Ganges near Bodhgaya, in what is today the Indian state of Bihar. Historically this area has been regarded as part of ancient India, though his birthplace—Lumbini—is now located in modern‑day Nepal.
